about: A rewrite of the sed text editing tool in Rust, aiming to work the same as GNU sed.

prs.title: Word start and word end markers now work on their own
prs.broken: The markers for the start and end of a word only worked when something else made the pattern a full search. On their own, sed looked for real angle brackets, unlike GNU sed.
prs.changed: These two markers now always turn on full pattern search, like the other word boundary markers already did.
prs.matters: Find and replace with whole words gives the same result as GNU sed.

prs.title: Two writes to the same file in one sed script now add up
prs.broken: When two w commands named the same file, each opened and emptied it on its own, so their writes overwrote each other.
prs.changed: Every command naming a file now shares one open copy, created once, like GNU sed.
prs.matters: Scripts that save lines to a file get every line, as with GNU sed.
